title: ScriptStatus
description: Entry shape used in running_scripts.json and completed_scripts.json (Script-Engine-Controller queues, read by script-studio host-data service).

script_id.description: UUID assigned when the script enters the queue.

script_name.description: Script name, or null for legacy/system entries that lacked a name.

start_time_str.description: UTC "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" — null until the script starts.

device_details.description: Either a structured object or a legacy device-id string (e.g. 'avd:Small_Phone_API_34'), or null.

args.description: Script constants/arguments. TODO: tighten once arg shape is finalized.

restart_device_on_crash.description: Set by ScriptScheduler restartDeviceOnCrash(): the controller runs the engine with --restart-device-on-crash, restarting the device when reconnecting to it fails.

showDetails.description: UI-only field added by script-studio. Should not be relied on server-side.
